46.context: Can use dynamic global environment capture when texture flags demand it.

limitations: Feature captures are exact only for documented canonical contexts in geometry-material-native-programs.json; GPU vendor, directional-lightmap, auxiliary render targets and live state can select more variants.
Ordered feature emissions preserve redefinitions. Last definition wins, as confirmed by original0x747320. Kind byte is preserved; full Nu2 source preprocessing is not reimplemented.
Float formulas fNNN mean float32 at material+hexNNN. Candidate inactive-effect formulas can divide by zero; this is marked explicitly and does not imply the native game uploads unused uniforms.
Original0x5dfbd0 UV mode128 follows the default zero-output branch for active layers; modes2/3/4 timing is native validated in geometry-uv-native-validation.json.
46 legacy materials preserve raw bytes and viewable geometry but are excluded from current-layout native shader invocation.
Lighting/environment/global shader constants, full rendering passes and final GPU pixel equivalence remain outside these material bindings.

rtti.relationship: ShaderManagerHLSL constructor 0x746020 constructs its HLSLShaderBuilder internally and supplies the embedded template at call 0x7460ac.
